tiefling-2024.label: Fiendish Legacy
tiefling-2024.description: Your legacy sets your damage resistance and the spells you learn (cantrip now, one spell at level 3 and one at level 5).

options.label: Abyssal
options.description: Poison Resistance; Poison Spray; Ray of Sickness (3rd); Hold Person (5th).

options.label: Chthonic
options.description: Necrotic Resistance; Chill Touch; False Life (3rd); Ray of Enfeeblement (5th).

options.label: Infernal
options.description: Fire Resistance; Fire Bolt; Hellish Rebuke (3rd); Darkness (5th).

goliath-2024.label: Giant Ancestry
goliath-2024.description: Choose a supernatural boon (uses equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest).

options.label: Cloud's Jaunt (Cloud Giant)
options.description: Bonus Action: teleport up to 30 feet.

options.label: Fire's Burn (Fire Giant)
options.description: When you hit, deal an extra 1d10 Fire damage.

options.label: Frost's Chill (Frost Giant)
options.description: When you hit, deal an extra 1d6 Cold damage and reduce the target's Speed by 10 feet.

options.label: Hill's Tumble (Hill Giant)
options.description: When you hit a Large or smaller creature, you can knock it Prone.

options.label: Stone's Endurance (Stone Giant)
options.description: Reaction: reduce damage taken by 1d12 + your Constitution modifier.

options.label: Storm's Thunder (Storm Giant)
options.description: Reaction: when damaged by a creature within 60 feet, deal 1d8 Thunder damage to it.

simic-hybrid.label: Animal Enhancement (1st level)
simic-hybrid.description: Your first animal enhancement. The 5th-level enhancement is described in the trait text.

options.label: Manta Glide
options.description: Ray-like fins slow your fall: subtract up to 100 feet from falling damage and glide 2 feet per foot descended.

options.label: Nimble Climber
options.description: You have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.

options.label: Underwater Adaptation
options.description: You can breathe air and water and have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

shifter-2024.label: Shifting
shifter-2024.description: Choose the benefit you gain whenever you shift.

options.label: Beasthide
options.description: You gain 1d6 additional Temporary Hit Points. While shifted, you have a +1 bonus to your Armor Class.

options.label: Longtooth
options.description: When you shift and as a Bonus Action on your other turns while shifted, you can use your elongated fangs to make an Unarmed Strike. If you hit with this Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can deal Piercing damage equal to 1d6 plus your Strength modifier, instead of the normal damage of an Unarmed Strike.

options.label: Swiftstride
options.description: While you are shifted, your Speed increases by 10 feet. Additionally, you can move up to 10 feet as a Reaction when a creature ends its turn within 5 feet of you. This reactive movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

options.label: Wildhunt
options.description: While shifted, you have Advantage on Wisdom checks. Additionally, no creature within 30 feet of you can have Advantage on an attack roll against you unless you have the Incapacitated condition.
